answer.rationale: The scenario matches OSHA-REC-024 directly: an authorized employee representative requesting OSHA 301 Incident Reports for a represented establishment. Per §1904.35(b)(2)(v)(B), the employer must provide only the 'Tell us about the case' section within 7 calendar days, redacting all other information. This is distinct from OSHA-REC-023 (individual employee requests, next business day) and OSHA-REC-015 (OSHA 300 Log requests), which do not apply to this specific request type.
